1 · Swap & Match

Tap a tile, then tap a neighbour — or swipe. Match 3 or more of the same creature-feature and every tile that's about to go lights up with a gold ring and glow first — so you can see the whole match, including any beam or bomb chain, before it pops. Tiles fall, new ones drop in, and chain reactions pay out bigger every time.

2 · Make the Specials

Match 4 and you forge a Projector Beam — match it again (or double-tap it) and it blasts its whole row or column. Match 5 for an Atomic Popcorn Bomb that clears everything around it. Swap two specials together and they combine into a Double Bill — two beams clear both lines, two bombs go off in a 5×5 blast, and a beam into a bomb clears a full cross plus a 3×3 patch.

3 · Beat the Showing

Hit the score target and finish the collection goals before your moves run out. There are 500 showings across 50 reels. The cast grows to seven tile types by Showing 3 and rotates every 5 showings from Showing 6 on — one face swaps out for a new one, so the board always holds seven types but the lineup keeps changing. A third collection goal arrives at Showing 21, and from Showing 8 the house exclusive appears: the Static Veil, a translucent sheet of haunted TV static clinging to board squares. Clear tiles on a veiled square to burn the static off that square — and a showing with static on it isn't beaten until every last wisp is gone. From Showing 31 some squares wear Dense Static that takes two hits. Beat a showing with moves to spare to earn stars — ★★★ for finishing with plenty of moves left, ★★ for a comfortable win, ★ for a win by any margin. One star is a win; the other two are for showing off.

4 · Concessions

Every point you score is banked as Points, and the stand under the board runs on two currencies. The blast shelf takes 🪙 Tokens — Dynamite Reel (3×3 blast, 2 tokens), Monster Mash (4×4 blast, 4 tokens), Ticket Punch (one tile, 1 token) — while Encore (+5 moves, 500 pts) and Scream Boost (fills the Scream Meter, 400 pts) still take banked Points. Earn Tokens by beating any showing (+1) and from Bonus Rounds (1 per 500 bonus points, up to 3 a round): beat any 5th showing (5, 10, 15, 20, then repeating) to trigger one — Fill the Vault, Frenzy Board, Haunted Doors and Midnight Screening rotate in that order, all no-fail. Tap a blast or the punch to arm it, then tap a tile — Encore and Scream Boost fire right away. The stand never spends your showing score. Run out of moves on a showing? The loss screen offers a Continue — 3 🪙 Tokens for +5 moves, once per attempt. And every tile you clear joins the Creature Gallery — open it from the button under the board to see your lifetime collection and the poster tiers.

5 · Tonight's Feature

One fresh showing every day — the same board for every player, dealt fresh each morning. Beat it and earn +3 🪙 Tokens the first time that day, and keep your streak alive: any daily beat counts, and a missed day gets one free grace day before the streak resets. A 7-day streak pays a +7 Token bonus.
